stories.title: California Winter Storm: Widespread road closures and power outages
stories.summary: Northern California braces for hazardous travel as a major winter storm brings heavy rain and mountain snow, possible road closures, and outages.

stories.title: Power outage impacting over 32,000 SMUD customers throughout Sacramento | Update
stories.summary: Most outages have been reported in the Citrus Heights area, with 25,401 outages reported as of 7:53 a.m.

stories.title: Sacramento Weather Forecast
stories.summary: Biggest storm of the season so far arrives Wednesday. Near whiteout conditions in the Sierra, heavy valley rain, gusty winds and snow level down to the foothills.

stories.title: Weather Impact Alert for the Strongest Storm This Season
stories.summary: Rounds of moderate to heavy rain, heavy snowfall rates, thunderstorms and strong winds are expected over the next 48 hours

stories.title: Sutter County city could lose around-the-clock firefighter staffing under proposed changes
stories.summary: The uncertainty over fire protection comes as the city prepares for another public safety reduction.

stories.title: Football stadium upgrades approved for Rio Americano High School
stories.summary: The San Juan Unified School Board approved the project on Tuesday night.

stories.title: PG&E lays off 15 employees in Sacramento County as over 200 jobs are cut statewide
stories.summary: PG&E is laying off employees across California as the company looks to reduce costs, streamline operations and address customer affordability concerns.

stories.title: San Joaquin County extends AI data center development moratorium
stories.summary: San Joaquin County supervisors extended a moratorium on hyperscale data centers to allow more time to study potential environmental and economic impacts.

stories.title: Sacramento County court disruptions continue amid worker strike
stories.summary: United Public Employees workers remain on strike as Sacramento County Superior Courts face continued disruptions over a wage dispute.

stories.title: Firefighters battle three-alarm fire at former Stockton Record building
stories.summary: The fire was in the area of East Market and South American streets. The Stockton Fire Department said crews responded around 7:30 a.m.

stories.title: 1 teenage girl killed, another injured after being hit in Linden crosswalk
stories.summary: One teenage girl died and another was injured after they were hit by a minivan in a Linden crosswalk Monday, according to CHP.

stories.title: Shelter-in-place lifted for Stockton area after reported gas leak
stories.summary: A reported gas leak near Highway 26 and White Lane in Stockton prompted a shelter-in-place order for residents within a quarter-mile radius.
